name: Emirate of Jabal Shammar (1836–1921)
description: A red field bearing a large yellow crescent toward the hoist and a yellow eight-pointed star in the upper fly.
history: The flag attributed to the Rashidi Emirate of Jabal Shammar, ruled from Ha'il: a red flag with a yellow crescent and eight-rayed star is shown for 'Arabia' in an American flag chart of 1858, and is linked by vexillologists to the emirate. Founded in 1836, the emirate was conquered by Ibn Saud on 2 November 1921 and absorbed into the Sultanate of Nejd.
